lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: Continuity Holdings. That's the name on every line of it. Eleven years, one signature, never a query, never a late payment, never a single thing out of place.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Two hundred and eighty-one years, actually. I have seen the other end of that ledger, and it looks exactly the same — which is the part that should worry somebody.

lines.speaker: dock_foreman
lines.text: Right. Well. If you do find out what's in the crates, don't tell me. I've a daughter and a mortgage and I've got quite good at not knowing things.
